Name: Arioch, Captain of the Guard
Summary: Arioch was captain of Nebuchadnezzar's guard who was sent to slay the wise men of Babylon when none could tell the king's dream; Daniel asked him why the decree was so hasty, and Arioch brought Daniel before the king. He is a different man from Arioch, king of Ellasar, who already has a profile.
KeyStory: Arioch was commanded to destroy the wise men, but Daniel sought him with counsel and wisdom, and Arioch brought Daniel in haste before the king.
LifeLesson: Even an executioner's errand can be interrupted by a wise question.
